content.text: Amy Dahl
Mom • Business Owner • Organizer of Fun Things
I like things simple, a little clever, and actually useful.
I'm Amy, based in Texas, juggling family, a small business, and whatever project I've decided to take on this week.
I like practical solutions, good ideas that don't require a ton of effort, and making things a little more fun than they need to be.
